text:
Alex H (cs-ops): Heads up — onboarding telemetry gaps showing up for a subset of trial accounts created 2024-11-01..2024-11-07. health_score is null on compute and playbook nudges might fire incorrectly. Anyone on data/ingest able to look? :warning:
Jordan L (data): I see the partition with missing `first_successful_message` events, looks like ingestion retries dropped between 10:22-10:47 UTC. Suspect partner webhook 429 backoff.
Maria T (cs): Which customers? I can pull a quick list and suppress outreach if needed. Don’t want CS reps spamming trial users.
Alex H (cs-ops): Impacting ~8 accounts in PROD (I'll paste IDs below). Ideally we: 1) suppress playbook nudges for accounts missing the event, 2) run an ad-hoc backfill to populate the event if available in raw logs, 3) audit the retry behavior.
Sam R (eng): Deploy last night touched the webhook relay. I already added extra logging but will check the 429 handling. If webhook provider responded 429 we should have queued retries; maybe lambda timed out.
Jordan L (data): I can run a backfill against raw ingestion logs. Dry-run first: `python tools/backfill_onboarding.py --start 2024-11-01 --end 2024-11-07 --dry-run --limit 500`
Sam R (eng): Do the dry run, and create a small patch to the playbook to suppress nudges where `events.first_successful_message == null AND account.touchpoints >= 3`
Maria T (cs): For suppression toggles, path is Console > Playbooks > Onboarding > Suppress-if-missing-event. I can apply a temporary suppression rule but need someone to own rollback after the backfill.
Alex H (cs-ops): I'll own rollback. Maria, can you add the rule and post the snippet here?
Maria T (cs): Adding now. Patch snippet:
```json
{ "playbook": "onboarding_primary", "rules": [ { "id": "suppress-missing-first-msg-2024-11", "condition": "events.first_successful_message == null && metadata.touchpoint_count >= 3", "action": "suppress_nudge", "expires_at": "2024-11-14T08:00:00Z", "notes": "Temporary suppression while we backfill missing events" } ] }
```
PlaybookBot: Playbook update accepted: suppress-missing-first-msg-2024-11 (applied by Maria T). :white_check_mark:
Jordan L (data): Dry-run completed — can populate 6 of 8 accounts from raw logs. Two accounts have no raw payloads and will need manual review. Will run actual backfill in ~15m: `python tools/backfill_onboarding.py --start 2024-11-01 --end 2024-11-07 --apply --ids 8`
Sam R (eng): FYI I found the lambda retry policy had maxAttempts=3 and a 1s base delay; provider 429 burst caused all attempts to fail in that window. Raising to exponential backoff and increasing timeout in a follow-up PR.
Alex H (cs-ops): Please add PR link when you have it. Also creating a short incident doc for the two accounts that need manual contact.
Maria T (cs): Backfill applied — events populated for 6 accounts. I removed them from the suppression list as soon as their health_score computed.
Jordan L (data): Backfill run result: `applied:6, missing_raw:2, errors:0`
Sam R (eng): Opened PR to change retry/backoff: https://git.company/repo/pull/4123 — tests passing, scheduling deploy after 11:00 UTC smoke window.
Alex H (cs-ops): Great. Action items: Sam deploy retry fix (PR 4123), Jordan to add ingestion alert for >1% missing first_successful_message, Maria to keep suppression in place until manual review done, Alex to create incident note and follow up with CS reps.
Maria T (cs): I emailed the two customers to schedule manual onboarding checks.
PlaybookBot: Incident note created: INCIDENT-2024-11-telemetry-gap-01 by Alex H.
Alex H (cs-ops): Closing thread here — thanks all. Will reopen if any regressions seen. :thumbsup:
